title: Druski Sings His Way Through His First Night Hosting 'SNL'
summary: Comedian Druski hosted Saturday Night Live for the first time, and he hit all the right notes, literally. The musical guest was The Strokes, but Druski singing 'she said yes' became the night's real earworm. Two sketches showed off his talent for musical comedy. In 'Proposal,' Jeremy Culhane plays a man asking his girlfriend, played by Sarah Sherman, to marry him. Things do not quite go as planned. He assumed she would say yes, so he went all-out to make it unforgettable, including hiring entertainment. 'I don't really know how to tell you this, but the next four minutes are about to be really tough,' Culhane says. All eyes turn to Druski and a growing group around him as he belts: 'She said yes, oh, she said yes.' The second standout sketch, 'Golden Age of Hip-Hop,' had the Druski-led crew performing funny songs. When Druski was announced as a host for the 52nd season, friends like Drake, Travis Scott, Quavo and Wheezy cheered him on. For a first-time host, Druski showed he could do more than tell jokes.
why_it_matters: If you like making your friends laugh, this story shows how a song can turn an awkward moment into the funniest joke of the night.
